transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As Director of Employee Relations, I've convened this case conference to address the complaint that's been raised concerning how disagreements between Leah and Daniel have been handled in group discussions during their cross-functional initiative work. Before we proceed, I want to outline how this will work: I'll hear from each participant in turn, I'll ask each person to formally place any relevant facts or prior arrangements on the case record, I'll confirm that everyone has had a chance to speak, and then I'll make a decision on the resolution path and working arrangements going forward. Our organization offers two paths for workplace conduct concerns: a formal investigation or a mutually agreed restorative process. I'll determine which path is appropriate based on what we discuss today. Let's begin — I'd like to start by hearing from the person who raised the complaint, and then we'll hear from Leah and Daniel in turn. Who would like to go first?
